options.serverlist.title: Server List Settings
options.serverlist.dragToReorder.tooltip: Reorder saved servers by dragging them in the server list.
options.serverlist.searchBox.tooltip: Show a search box above the server list's buttons. Takes effect the next time the server list is opened.
options.serverlist.showPingMs.tooltip: Show each server's latency in milliseconds next to its player count.
options.serverlist.pauseMenuButton.toolt: Show a button in the pause menu that opens the server list.
options.serverlist.fasterServerPings.too: Ping more servers at once, so slow or unreachable servers do not hold up the others. Vanilla pings at most five at a time.
options.serverlist.skipReverseDnsForIpAd: Do not look up host names for servers entered as IP addresses. This can make pinging and joining them several seconds faster.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.serverlis: Makes the multiplayer server list more usable: drag-and-drop reordering, edit and delete shortcuts, search, faster pings, quick access from the pause menu, and a shared area on the server info screen for other mods.
